newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil high court rejects challenge to CVRD sale. [CORRECTED 20:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil high court rejects challenge to CVRD sale. [CORRECTED 20:40 GMT]

text.p: Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal, rejected a constitutional challenge against the privatization of mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.
The STF voted unanimously against the case, brought by the Order of Brazilian Lawyers, which alleged the privatization plan broke constitutional rules.

In a separate case, an STF judge was set to rule on Monday another challenge to the CVRD sell-off lodged by a left-wing political party, also seeking an injuction against the CVRD privatization (corrects to say the judge has not yet ruled on the case).
Up to 100 lawsuits have been filed across the country against the CVRD sell-off, Latin America's biggest privatization to date.
However, the government is still confident it can fight off the challenges and hold the auction as planned at 1000 local time/1300 GMT Tuesday.
